package composeconfig

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteComposeConfig removes compose config by id.
type DeleteComposeConfig struct {
	ComposeConfigs repository.ComposeConfigRepository
}

// Handle deletes compose config.
func (uc DeleteComposeConfig) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	return uc.ComposeConfigs.Delete(ctx, id)
}
